## Purpose
The workflow runs this browser started or opened, and the notifications for them (finished, failed, waiting for review). It is persisted so a reload keeps watching and never announces the same review twice.

## Responsibilities
- **Limits:** `MAX_WATCHED = 40`, `MAX_NOTIFICATIONS = 50`.
- **`WatchedExecution`:** execution_id, workflow_name, status, started_at, finished_at.
- **`AppNotification`:**
  - id;
  - kind: review, completed or failed;
  - title, body, workflow_name, execution_id, review_id, step_id;
  - created_at, read.
- **`useExecutionWatch`:**
  - **`watch`** is a no-op when the status has not changed; it keeps the newest 40;
  - `settle(id, status)` and `unwatch`;
  - **`notify`** de-duplicates by id and returns whether it was new;
  - markRead, markAllRead, `markExecutionRead(executionId, kind?)`, clear;
  - **`announceReview(id)`** keeps the last 200 review ids.

It is persisted under the key `workflow-execution-watch` (version 1).

## Key elements
`useExecutionWatch`, `AppNotification`.

## Control flow
None. The polling is done by `components/runs/ExecutionWatcher`.

localStorage.
